claim: FSSAI food adulteration complaints have risen sharply: 4,330 in 2022-23, 4,735 in 2023-24, and 7,705 in 2024-25 — indicating a growing food safety enforcement challenge in India.
stance_target: Scale of food safety problems in India
scope_conditions: India, all food categories including supplements, 2022-2025
quoted_support: More than 7,700 complaints related to food adulteration and safety were received in 2024-25, out of which nearly 6,000 have been resolved, the Parliament was informed.

claim: FSSAI enforcement is decentralized: ground-level action is carried out by state food safety authorities (designated officers and FSOs), not FSSAI centrally, creating potential inconsistency across India's 28 states.
stance_target: Effectiveness of India food safety enforcement
quoted_support: Enforcement at the ground level is mainly carried out by state food safety authorities through designated officers and food safety officers.
